mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependency.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 6.5% for three consecutive months indicates labor market weakness that suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 6.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction that reduces corporate revenue visibility, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 235) triggers monetary tightening expectations that increase equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days during inflationary regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 235, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high non-farm payrolls level (above 137,000 thousand) signals robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 137,000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 100.5 indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output capacity and earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.5, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Real GDP level below 15,900 billion signals economic stagnation that suppresses corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days during slow-growth regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 < 15900, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 235) creates stagflationary pressure that constrains monetary policy effectiveness, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and CPIAUCSL > 235, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
